body.name: \(\beta(A,r)\)
body.construction: For every \(A\subseteq V\), \(r\in V\setminus A\), and \(a\in M\), set \(\beta^{(a)}(A,r)[A]=\Sigma^{aa}[r,A]\{\Sigma^{aa}[A,A]\}^{-1}\) and \(\beta^{(a)}(A,r)[V\setminus A]=0\), with the whole row zero when \(A=\varnothing\); collect these viewwise rows as \(\beta(A,r)\).
